objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with a concerning rash and recent health changes.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello—what brings you in today, and could you tell me what’s been going on? Patient: I’m 47, and I developed a rash on the upper half of my back starting last night. I’m really concerned because I don’t remember any new exposures like detergents or plants, and I’ve also had a new cough along with some mouth/mucosal soreness.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any skin excoriations—like small scratches, open sore areas, or areas where the skin looks rubbed raw—anywhere on your body? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any scratch marks, open sore areas, or skin rubbed raw anywhere else.

turns.doctor_question: Have you ever been told that you stop breathing during sleep, or have you noticed episodes where you briefly stop breathing and then gasp or wake up? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t been told that I stop breathing during sleep, and I haven’t noticed any episodes where I briefly stop and then gasp or wake up.

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury or fall, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—like severe pain, swelling, deformity, or trouble using the injured area? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t had any injury or fall, so I don’t have severe pain, swelling, deformity, or trouble using any area.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist**? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any redness or warmth on my left wrist.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, dark or discolored areas on the chest), especially after an injury or coughing?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any bruising on my chest wall, and I don’t recall any dark or discolored areas after coughing.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed peeing much more than usual—no increased frequency or larger urine amounts.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any substances such as alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs in the past or currently?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: I don’t use tobacco, cannabis, opioids, or stimulants, and I don’t drink alcohol regularly. If you want, you can tell me what other substance you’re concerned about.

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking urine or needing to rush to the bathroom and not making it in time? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t had any trouble controlling my urine—no leaking and no rush or inability to make it in time.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any new or changing skin lesion (such as a new spot, sore, mole, or patch) anywhere on your body?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: I’ve only noticed the new rash on the upper half of my back—no other new or changing spots, sores, or patches anywhere else. It started last night and I haven’t identified any separate lesions in other areas.

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any nosebleeds recently (even if they were mild or only lasted a short time)?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t had any nosebleeds recently.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rash on your trunk (chest, back, or belly)?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: Yes—it's on my upper back, which is part of my trunk, and it started last night. I haven’t noticed it on my chest or belly.
